content: How much protein should I eat to build muscle?

Aim for about 1.6–2.2 g of protein per kg of bodyweight per day. That's roughly 1.6 g/kg at minimum, and going higher gives little extra benefit. Spread it over 3–5 meals with about 0.3–0.4 g/kg each, and keep total calories at or slightly above maintenance so you can grow. 💪

If you tell me your bodyweight, I'll work out your daily number.
